MTBF = （Scheduled time – unscheduled downtime）/ Number of failures， 计算依据如下：
a. Scheduled Time – 设备计划用于生产的时间 20 h/天 × 7 days/week (360 days/years) = 7920 hours/years.
b. Failure –由设备造成无法继续生产的原因（ 仅限设备原因不含其它人为，天灾故障），包括设备故障或潜在的超出设备工艺技术规范要求的质量隐患

items.project: FPC密码管理FPC Password Management
items.specification:
FPC密码管理总共分3阶,不可越權修改
一阶密码:操作员密码，功能：开机生产,停线保养，例：扫码调参
二阶密码:工程师密码，功能：生产参数设定修改，例：温度/线速/时间
三阶密码:开发者密码，功能：机台运转内参设定,系统能力参数调整,舉例：能量/补偿等
FPC password management is divided into three levels, with no unauthorized modifications allowed.  

**Level 1 Password:** Operator password. Functions include starting up production and performing line maintenance—for example, scanning codes to adjust parameters.  

**Level 2 Password:** Engineer password. Allows modification of production parameters—such as temperature, line speed, and timing.  

**Level 3 Password:** Developer password. Enables adjustments to internal machine settings and system performance parameters—such as energy levels and compensation settings.
